Web Wizard
Grade 8–9 · Coding

Build websites. See them live.

Web Wizard puts an HTML and CSS editor next to a live preview, so every change shows up as learners type. A guided tutorial covers page structure, styling, classes, flexbox layout and colour, and the preview switches between phone, tablet and desktop sizes so learners see why responsive design matters.

Questions

Is a server or hosting needed?

No. Everything runs in the browser; learners can save their work and load it again later.

Who is it for?

Grade 8–9 learners meeting web design for the first time, and older learners who need a quick way to try HTML and CSS.

How much does it cost?

Web Wizard is one of thirteen tools on The Magic Lab. Start with a free account; full access to every tool is one plan, and schools can get a quote for all their learners and teachers.
